name: Gridify Plus
author: WPXERO

sections.description:
Gridify Plus is the ultimate solution for creating beautiful WooCommerce product grids, blog post grids, and carousels inside your WordPress site. With advanced customization, Elementor integration, and vendor information display, it helps you engage users, build trust, and boost conversions.

🔑 Key Features:

  • Beautiful Grid Layouts – Choose from multiple grid styles with flexible column and row configurations for posts or WooCommerce products.
  • Product Carousels – Display your products in sleek, responsive carousels with smooth navigation.
  • Vendor Info Display – Show vendor name and image alongside products for added trust and transparency.
  • WooCommerce Integration – Works seamlessly with WooCommerce ensuring full compatibility.
  • Elementor Ready – Drag-and-drop product and post grids directly into your Elementor pages without coding.
  • Advanced Styling Options – Customize typography, colors, hover effects, spacing, and more.
  • User-Friendly Interface – Simple setup with intuitive controls for beginners and pros.
  • Optimized UX – Enhance customer trust and engagement with clean layouts and vendor transparency.

Whether you’re running a blog, online shop, or multi-vendor marketplace, Gridify Plus is the perfect toolkit to display content in a modern and engaging way.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. From your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and select the downloaded ZIP file.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. Start building your grids under Elementor or via shortcodes.
sections.faq:
Does it work without Elementor?

Yes. While Gridify Plus is optimized for Elementor, it also provides shortcode support for placing grids anywhere.

Can I use this for blog posts only?

Absolutely. You can use Gridify Plus to showcase blog posts, WooCommerce products, or both.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce multi-vendor plugins?

Yes, vendor information display works well with popular multi-vendor setups.
